## Orientation

Parallel tasks in this wave edit disjoint files. Stay inside your task scope. Install node_modules in your worktree with `npm ci` in `dashboard/web/ui` when you need npm. Do not push.

Write root: `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/remove-textual--fix-review-findings`

### Work-item (quote)

## Description

R5: The CI file has no tmux job, and `pytest.ini` has no `tmux` marker. No doc, fallback command, or pinning test may still depend on the removed tmux pass.

Review findings to fix: (1) README Testing section (about lines 500-515) still describes four pytest processes and a `-m tmux` pass and `--reruns 2`; (2) `orchestra/conductor/suite.py` builds a fallback chain `FAST_SUITE_CMD && TMUX_SUITE_CMD`, and `tests/test_tiered_verification.py` pins it; (3) the deleted `tests/test_dashboard_uv_env.py` probed that `dashboard/bin/web` starts a process that can import `orchestra.canon.project`; (4) `skills/plan-phase/references/task-shapes.md` line 92 names the deleted `tests/test_dashboard_app.py`.

## Approach

(1) Rewrite the README Testing section to the three remaining pytest commands that CI runs (`test-canon`, `test-tuner`, `test-orchestra`); remove the tmux pass, the `-m "not tmux"` fallback, and the `--reruns 2` text. (2) In `suite.py`, make the fallback command the fast suite only (drop `TMUX_SUITE_CMD` and the chain; the suite still runs inside a tmux session, which is unchanged), and update `tests/test_tiered_verification.py` to pin the new shape and README text. Do not edit `.canon/config.json`. (3) Add a test to `tests/test_web_dashboard_launch.py` that starts the `dashboard/bin/web` launcher environment and checks `orchestra.canon.project` is importable (follow the style of the existing launch tests; read the deleted test with `git show HEAD~12:tests/test_dashboard_uv_env.py` or `git log --diff-filter=D -- tests/test_dashboard_uv_env.py`). (4) Change the example to an existing test file. If `skills/` has generated copies, run `python3 scripts/build_skills.py` and then `python3 scripts/build_skills.py --check`. Run `uvx ruff@0.13.1 check .`.

### Requirements (quote by id)

R5: The CI file has no tmux job, and `pytest.ini` has no `tmux` marker.

### Design / decisions (quote)

- The server starts and serves a snapshot after each task.
- Files move without content change, other than imports.

- Nothing outside the `dashboard` package imports the deleted modules.
- The tmux tests are the only tests that need the tmux marker.

- `web-replaces-tmux`: The web UI replaces the tmux dashboard
